data.speaker: vale
data.message: Perimeter clear. Get a robot beside the yellow contractor van and secure the equipment.

data.speaker: vale
data.message: The recovery operator has relinquished the load. The equipment stays. Access control is at the exchange's service door.

data.speaker: vale
data.message: East gate released. The owners' service van is coming in. Keep the yard and the concourse approaches covered while their crew restores dispatch.

data.speaker: vale
data.message: The workshop can see four response machines coming west along the street. Same pistol equipment as the perimeter.

data.speaker: vale
data.message: Two more at the north end of the east ramp. They're taking the concourse above the service lane.

data.speaker: sable
data.message: The local dispatcher is answering. The owners have control again. Their delivery orders are running.

data.speaker: morrow
data.message: The exchange is theirs and the response is finished. Bring the surviving squad back to the pickup bay beside the west ramp.
